title: Semi-Structured Interview Guide – Innovation Adoption in Nigerian SMEs
purpose: Elicit rich narratives about why and how SMEs adopt innovation, constraints faced, enabling factors, and tangible impacts on performance.

ethics_and_consent.intro_script: Thank you for speaking with us. This conversation is voluntary and confidential. We will use a pseudonym and remove identifiers. You can skip any question or stop at any time. With your permission, we will record notes for analysis.
ethics_and_consent.permission_prompt: Do you consent to participate and for us to use anonymized data for research?
ethics_and_consent.privacy_notes: Avoid collecting personally identifiable information or trade secrets; focus on experiences, processes, and outcomes.

core_questions: Please tell me about your business: sector, size, and how long you have operated.
What are your current products/services and typical customers?
What was 2023-2025 like for your business in terms of growth and challenges?
Tell me the story of when you decided to adopt [X technology/practice].
What problem were you trying to solve?
Who championed this internally and who resisted?
probes: Catalyst event (e.g., loss, regulation, competitor move, new client demand)
Decision criteria (cost, reliability, skills, vendor support)

core_questions: What were the biggest hurdles and how did you navigate them?
Which constraint was binding (power, broadband, finance, skills, policy, trust, etc.)?
What helped you move forward (peers, government support, platforms, vendors)?
probes: Vendor lock-in or data access limitations

core_questions: How did adoption affect sales, costs, customer relationships, or productivity?
What evidence supports this (POS reports, delivery times, rejection rates, downtime logs)?
probes: Sector-specific impacts (e.g., spoilage, fuel, lead times)

core_questions: What would you do differently if repeating this journey?
What advice would you give a peer considering the same innovation?
What role should government, banks, or platforms play?

closing.thanks_script: Thank you for your time. We will share a brief summary of insights after analysis, if you wish.
closing.follow_up: May we contact you for clarification if needed?
